method: Renders r_w9 (head 250f186) compared crop-by-crop with r_w8. References: omaat_f7, f57, f58, f60, f61, ml_30, up_10, up_34, official f_17313. Colours are PIL box means, compared as ratios within one image. Code: src/09d_suite.js (337 lines at 250f186).

calibration.earlier_issue: w8b MED: weak body/cap two-tone (shells almost as light as the caps)
calibration.status: fixed. fShell #57524d (line 22). In q03 the right wall reads L84 against the cap at L149-152, a ratio of 0.55-0.56 (w8: L106 / L145 = 0.73). Official f_17313 is about 0.5; in-flight omaat_f57 is 0.53. The hue is still neutral; see the cap-hue issue.

calibration.earlier_issue: w8a MED: keypad + handset lie nearly flat on a slab module
calibration.status: partly fixed, and a new form problem. Lines 166-167 build a 35 deg wedge with both parts on its face, which matches the slope in f57. But the wedge is a sharp-edged straight extrusion standing 0.135 above the console top (y0 0.787 + 0.012 lip against 0.665). It reads as a lectern or door-stop block in s4, s5, v2 and q02. See issues.

calibration.earlier_issue: w8a/w8b MED: crease rods on the duvet; the fold band reads as a separate white board
calibration.status: rods fixed (line 290 area, none in q04 / s5). The band is partly fixed: it now uses the duvet colour (line 289), but it still reads as a raised rounded board with a hard outline and a cast shadow across the bed in q04 (x 400-470) and s5.

calibration.earlier_issue: w8a MED: the centre pier mirror is too narrow and tall
calibration.status: fixed. Line 105 sets the centre mirror to 0.17 x 0.32 at scy - 0.05, with the lamp above its outer corner. The q02 crop now shows a broad, low pill, as in omaat_f32 / f13.

calibration.earlier_issue: w8a LOW: the window mirror is narrow (0.103)
calibration.status: fixed. pAng is now 68 deg (line 96), which gives mW 0.13. In q03 / s2 the pill reads about 0.12 projected.

calibration.earlier_issue: w8b LOW: the vanity mirror has square corners
w8a/w8b LOW: dashed seam on the centre fin's aft edge
calibration.status: fixed. Lines 90-91 use square-edged 0.028 strips across the centre plane. The q02 crop shows a clean continuous taupe edge.

calibration.earlier_issue: w8a/w8b LOW: the fluted field is too light
calibration.status: fixed. In v1, cap / field = 197 / 88 = 2.24 (w8: 1.77). Real values are f60 2.34, ml_30 1.81 and f61 1.66. Field / flank = 2.3; real is 2.0-2.9.

calibration.earlier_issue: w8a LOW: the handset screen is sky blue
calibration.status: fixed in cabin light (q02 / q04 deep blue #1e2c9a). In studio light it is still pale lavender (s4), which is lighting.

calibration.earlier_issue: w8a LOW: caps are cream-grey, not olive-khaki
calibration.status: not fixed. fCap #8e897d (line 22) has R-B 17, and v1 renders the cap #ccc7bc (R-B 16). In-flight caps are #aea786 (f60, R-B 40), #998973 (ml_30, R-B 38) and #7c7b66 (f57).

calibration.earlier_issue: w8a LOW: far LOD has no window wing or pier wood (pop at the switch)
calibration.status: not fixed. Lines 318-336 are unchanged and v5 shows no dark wood beside the far screen.

calibration.earlier_issue: w8b LOW: niche header and seat-back top are square
calibration.status: not fixed. Line 268 is still a 0.09 header and line 270 still uses fr 0.035.

calibration.earlier_issue: w8b LOW: residual moire on the fluted leaves at grazing angles
calibration.status: not fixed. The q02 right edge (x 700-930) still shows a stipple pattern on the far leaves. Line 19 keeps the gap/slat ratio at about 0.8.

calibration.earlier_issue: w8a/w8b out of scope: horizontal tweed too light, hard sun patches, cream caps under cabin light
calibration.status: unchanged. q04 still has hard sun patches on the bed and q05 one on the ottoman. These belong to the lighting owner.

issues.issue: The keypad/handset module is a sharp-edged wedge block that stands about 0.135 above the console top, so it reads as a lectern or door stop sitting on the console. On the real console the sloped control face is a low, sculpted part of the console's aft end: in f58 / f7 / up_34 its top is roughly level with the console's top line, and its edges are softly radiused.
issues.evidence: s4 crop (r_w9 vs r_w8), s5 / v2 (a tall box at the window), q02 crop (a large slab face). Real: omaat_f58 x 650-840 y 300-345 and up_34 x 400-620 y 540-600, where the control face is a shallow band flush with the console's upper contour.
issues.fix: 09d_suite.js line 166: ka 35 -> 22*DEG and y1 0.685 -> 0.672, so y0 = 0.672 + 0.145*tan22 = 0.731 (lip top 0.743, about 0.08 above the console instead of 0.135). Line 167: round the profile by inserting a 3-point arc at [xs0, y0] (r 0.015) and at [xs1, y1]. Alternatively, build the wedge as gLoft sections so the aft and forward ends taper down to the console top over 0.04 rather than ending in flat triangular faces. Lines 169 and 184 follow ka automatically.

issues.issue: The leaves start too low. On the real suite each leaf (and the flanks) sits on a ~0.15-0.20 m taupe plinth with a chrome strip at its top and a recessed grip slot, so the fluted field is shorter (~1.0 m) and the leaf is about half as wide as it is tall. In the render the leaves run from 0.10 m, with only a thin LED strip below, so they read tall and narrow and the base looks unfinished.
issues.evidence: up_34 right leaf: 555 px wide x 1045 px tall over a 200 px plinth with a recessed slot (plinth / leaf 0.19). omaat_f60 and f7 show the same base band with slot and chrome strip. Render v1 / s6: the leaf aspect is 0.50 / 1.125 = 0.44 on a 0.06-0.10 base.
issues.fix: 09d_suite.js line 228: ly0 0.10 -> 0.18. Lines 240 and 249: move the fLed strip to y 0.17 and give it a brushed-metal material ({c:'#b9b6b0', r:0.35, m:0.8}) so it reads as the chrome strip. Add a plinth face for each leaf and flank: B.add(gBox(0.012, 0.16, len), M4.trs(x + 0.006, 0.09, (z0+z1)/2), SEATMAT.fShell), plus a recessed slot gBox(0.004, 0.035, 0.08) in SEATMAT.black at y 0.08 near the outer end. Line 248: the flank start at 0.10 follows.

issues.issue: The duvet fold-back band still reads as a separate raised board with a hard outline and its own shadow across the bed. The real fold is a soft turned-back sheet edge, and the duvet surface is rumpled with a diagonal turned corner (f58).
issues.evidence: q04 x 400-470 y 185-435 (bright slab with a dark under-shadow); s5 / v2 the same. omaat_f57 / f58 show no stiff band.
issues.fix: Line 289: height 0.025 -> 0.012, crown 0.006 -> 0.002, edge 0.012 -> 0.03, and lower the origin y 0.567 -> 0.556 so it sits half-embedded in the duvet crown. Alternatively, delete the band and add a diagonal turned-back triangle (gExtrude of [[0,0],[0.35,0],[0,0.30]], 0.01 thick) at the aisle-head corner in duv, as in f58.

issues.issue: The caps and body are neutral grey-cream. Real caps are a warm olive-khaki and the body is taupe-brown. The value contrast is now right, but the hue makes the suite read 'grey office partition' rather than JAMCO taupe/khaki.
issues.evidence: Render cap in v1 is #ccc7bc (R-B 16) and the q03 shell #585350 (R-B 8). In-flight caps: f60 #aea786 (R-B 40), ml_30 #998973 (38), f57 #7c7b66 (22). In-flight niche f57: #4d3d2f (30). The official f_17313 is cooler and appears colour-graded, so warm only part-way.
issues.fix: Line 22: fCap '#8e897d' -> '#8f8a72' (R-B ~29), and fShell '#57524d' -> '#5a5249' (keeps the luminance, R-B ~17).

issues.issue: The aisle box top/sides (fInner) and the console fascia (fConsole) render much lighter than the shell, almost cream in studio. In the official photo the aisle box is only slightly lighter than the shell.
issues.evidence: q03: aisle box #958f8a L144 vs shell L84 (1.7x). f_17313: box #686362 L101 vs shell L74-90 (1.1-1.35x). s4: console L168 vs cap L211 (0.8); f57: console L71-89 vs cap L117 (0.6-0.75).
issues.fix: Add suite-only overrides to the Object.assign at lines 10-24: fConsole: { c: '#6a645d', r: 0.45, l: LAYER.plastic } (the suite is its only user, per the w8 note) and fInner: { c: '#6e6862', r: 0.5, l: LAYER.plastic }. Check with grep first that fInner is not shared; if it is, use a new fBox material at lines 118 and 126-128.

issues.issue: The far LOD still has no window wing or pier wood, so the dark verticals beside the screen pop in at the LOD switch.
issues.fix: After line 335: if (!c) B.add(gBox(0.10, H - 0.68, 0.03), M4.trs(-hx + 0.08, 0.68 + (H - 0.68)/2, -L + 0.135), SEATMAT.fWood). For both kinds add a pier box: B.add(gBox(0.20, H - 0.645, 0.03), M4.trs(scx + 0.56, 0.645 + (H - 0.645)/2, -L + 0.20, -(c ? 74 : 68)*DEG), SEATMAT.fWood).

issues.issue: The niche header is still a square 0.09 band with small 0.035 fillets. The real niche (f57 / f61) has a thick header and large rounded inner corners carrying the lamps.
issues.fix: Line 268: header height 0.12 (centre H - 0.06). Line 270: fr 0.035 -> 0.06, using H - 0.12 in place of H - 0.09 in fp. Check that the 1.14 back top still clears.

issues.issue: Residual stipple moire on the far fluted leaves at grazing angles.
issues.fix: Line 19: fFluteGap '#3b3a33' -> '#424037' (groove/slat about 0.88). The slat side faces from line 236 still give the rhythm.

issues.issue: Out of scope (lighting owner): hard-edged sun patches on the bed (q04) and ottoman (q05). The handset screen turns lavender under studio fill.
issues.fix: 12_scene.js / 04_shaders.js: soften the window sun LUT penumbra.

questions: Should the leaf plinth (about 0.18 m with a grip slot, up_34) be adopted? It shortens the fluted field to about 1.0 m.
Colour authority for the caps: the official f_17313 is neutral/cool, but every in-flight photo shows olive-khaki caps over a warm taupe body. Is a middle hue acceptable?
